verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a dedicated sandbox ('payment-sim') that simulates pay-ins and payouts consistently across accounts, which covers part of the story, but there is no explicit documentation of sandbox coverage for currency conversions (Transfers v3) or of deterministic test values/testnet behavior for those flows. missing for 10: sandbox coverage for conversions/Transfers API, explicit deterministic test-value behavior, and independent developer confirmation of sandbox fidelity.
